package probe

// census-want: 1
// A lease-taking literal that is no WalkChain attempt.

import wire "github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/llm"

func serve(ctx context.Context, b backends.Backend) {
	f := func(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration) {
		_, _ = wire.ChatRaw(runCtx, *b, nil, t, 0)
	}
	f(ctx, &b, nil, time.Second)
}
